assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.

A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during these symptomatic episodes to guide further management and assess the burden of arrhythmia, directly addressing the diagnosed condition.
This appeal contests denial code PR-204, as the service is supported by the documented clinical indication of recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea requiring rhythm monitoring.
